message: Done, both. A positive assertion beside each negative one, so an empty $scan_err can no longer pass both greps while checking nothing.
Done, the progname argument is gone. lfs.c:1498 has the same duplication and is left alone here.
Done. An early `if (pathstart == -1) return false;` above it, and the condition is plain `i < pathend`.
Done. llapi_name_verify(optarg, "_-", LUSTRE_MAXFSNAME, "filesystem") replaces both the helper and the fprintf, so too long is told apart from a bad character. conf-sanity 300's grep moved with it.

Not done, and worth saying so rather than marking this resolved: the body still does not mention it. You are right that `lfs find -f` and `--f` were --foreign and are now ambiguous, and that any new f* option does this. It is on the board for the next time this change is touched.
Done. A comment on the store says the three are borrowed from argv rather than strdup()ed, and that lfs_find_parse_fini() must not learn to free them.
